svg.title: OP-05 — EVENT HORIZON: Scroll past the point of no return.

g.text: Scroll past the point of no return.
A cinematic scroll story around a real-time black hole. A WebGL2 shader
traces every pixel's photon path through Schwarzschild spacetime, so
the shadow, photon ring and lensed disk come from the physics.
Per-pixel GR ray tracing in GLSL
PhishGuard-protected via a custom Astro integration
